task: Find the shipping cost of a Common medium-sized box in flat-rate shipping and compare it with other parcel services.
agent_final_answer:
On UPS.com, flat-rate shipping is offered via UPS Simple Rate. The Common MEDIUM-sized box (251-650 cubic inches; common box dimensions 8x8x8 in, 12x9x6 in, 13x11x2 in; size samples: shoebox or 3-inch three-ring binder) starts at $18.95.

Full UPS Simple Rate flat-rate box pricing for reference: Extra Small $12.20, Small $15.80, Medium $18.95, Large $24.85, Extra Large $30.95.

How UPS Simple Rate compares to other parcel services (FedEx and USPS), per UPS's comparison table:
Feature | UPS | FedEx | USPS
Customer Packaging | Yes | No | No
Maximum Volume | Up to 1,728 cubic inches | Up to 1,452 cubic inches | Up to 1,200 cubic inches
Shipping Speeds | Within Five Days, Within Three Business Days, Second Day and Next-Day | Express Services only (no ground) | Priority Mail 1-3 business days
Declared Value | $100 | $100 | $50
Guaranteed | Yes | Yes | No
Shipping Rates | National Flat Rate | 3 Zones | National Flat Rate
